data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name Yeva, meaning 'life' or 'lively'. In the Bible, Iveta is not a direct name, but the name Eve, meaning 'life', is the mother of all living. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Iveta usually hope their child will grow to embody god's reward and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Ιβέτα
in_greek.meaning: Ζωή από τον Θεό, δωρεά Θεού

By bearing this name, an individual is encouraged to embrace life fully, while also recognizing the importance of staying spiritually connected to their Creator.
